question:
I'm trying to add a date column in the following format: {Year} {Month Number} 2021-01. If possible, also a column with the month name: 2021 Jan. Right now what I did is, which gives [YYYY/MM/DD]

CAST(l_i.created_date as DATE) as Date
title: Date Formatting {Year} {Month Number}
answer:
You can solve it with this way:

SELECT
  CAST(l_i.created_date as DATE) as date_column,
  DATE_FORMAT(CAST(l_i.created_date as DATE), '%Y %m %Y-%m') as formatted_date,
  DATE_FORMAT(CAST(l_i.created_date as DATE), '%Y %b') as month_name
FROM
  table_name l_i
